headline: Gold up about 2.9% today after a sharp dip, silver jumps 3% to ₹1,70,000 per kg
summary: Gold rose about 2.9% today, with 24K at ₹12,840 per gram and 22K at ₹11,770, a move of ₹360 and ₹330 from yesterday. Over the last 7 days gold is still up about 2.3%, but over the full 33 days shown it is down about 10%, from a high of ₹14,602 on 5 November to a low of ₹12,328 on 25 November. Silver rose about 3% today to ₹1,70,000 per kg, yet it is down about 23% since 26 October, and it is still below its 20 November level. A stronger rebound from the late-November lows, along with rupee and US dollar moves, are the likely drivers, though the data does not confirm the exact cause.
outlook: Prices have bounced from recent lows but remain well below early-November levels, so if you are buying for a specific purpose, compare the day's rate with your jeweller's making charges and GST before committing.
